Collapse linked records to Root Incident / Episode Cluster ID before confidence claims.
Stratify synthetic vs production/governance evidence before combined interpretation.
Inspect actor/model, task-family, package-profile, assistance and decision-axis overlap before any closure-ladder inference.
Run all eight Preview/Start falsification tests.
Evaluate H1/H2/H3/H4 without preference for H1.
If H2 and H3 remain observationally indistinguishable or material coverage gaps could reverse the conclusion, select H4.

mandatory_falsification_tests.effect: No population model ranking or actor-independent scalar threshold can be inferred.

bounded_findings: Current evidence does not support adopting a simple one-dimensional Universal execution-closure ladder.
Current evidence also does not prove that no useful one-dimensional core exists; H2 and H3 remain unresolved against each other.
Package profile, legacy level labels, task size and risk cannot be used as scalar Universal Level proxies from this corpus.
A future conclusion phase requires better matched production evidence across actors and decision axes, especially structured-Q/correct-STOP and unassisted comparable tasks.
next_evidence_requirements: At least one production/non-synthetic structured-Q or semantic-underdetermination episode with independent adjudication.
At least one production/non-synthetic correct Hard STOP episode with independent adjudication.
Matched or near-matched task-family/decision-axis observations across at least two actors without materially different assistance conditions.
Additional DeepSeek V4 Pro (or another actor) eligible clusters; one cluster is insufficient for actor comparison.
At least one unassisted production slice comparable to the assisted DeepSeek V4 Flash production slice.
Preserve root-cluster identity so retries/repairs do not inflate evidence weight.
non_inference: This Work-01 selects an evidence disposition only. H4_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is not a Universal Level definition and does not authorize Level/Profile/Selector/model-ranking/routing design.
